fixture_metadata.description: Conservative CloudMini API v2 endpoint metadata derived from the documented contract. This is not the raw provider OpenAPI document and no undocumented parameters, schemas, or capabilities are added.

body.name: CloudMini API

endpoints.use: Read public plans, prices, OS options, regions, ISP options, and protocols
Read an order by upstream order ID
Purchase a VPS or static proxy service
Read action names supported by the account
Renew or execute a supported service action
Purchase a rotating residential bandwidth package
List rotating residential packages and usage

envelope.rule: Both the HTTP status and the error field must be checked. A 200 response is not a successful operation when error is true. msg is diagnostic text only; the provider exposes no stable machine-readable error codes.

documented_http_failures.400: Invalid request or low balance. Definitive failure; do not retry.
documented_http_failures.401: Invalid or missing token. Disable provisioning and alert an administrator.
documented_http_failures.429: Another account transaction is being processed. Release the request, back off, and retry under the provider lock.
documented_http_failures.500: Provider internal error. Ambiguous for write requests; enter manual recovery.

known_catalog_inconsistencies: Querying type=nn returns an item whose internal type is normal.
An unsupported filter can return the complete catalog instead of an error.
Some plan groups have an empty region list.
Some prices act as disabled-plan sentinel values.
Numeric constraints can be encoded as strings such as int[1-16].
The OpenAPI enum and catalog values are not fully aligned.
not_documented: idempotency keys or client order references
delete, terminate, suspend, or unsuspend endpoints
sandbox account or non-billable provisioning endpoint
